BOBBY WORKBOOK TASK 10 (Sept 30). Bobby owns execution: AI discovers accounts and drafts fields; Bobby opens/recovers accounts, verifies, confirms the public result. Improve existing profiles rather than duplicate. Source: KMD Analytical SEO GEO Scorecard and Activation Checklist (Sept 25), pages 4 and 6–8. Verify the canonical domain (kmdanalytical.com) before using 'KMDAnalytics.com' anywhere.

PRIORITY CHANNELS: Google Business Profile (verify ownership; category, hours, contact, services, real lab photos) · Instagram @kmd.analytical (bio, links, visuals, highlights, three pinned explainers) · LinkedIn company page (About, services, banner, three approved educational posts) · YouTube (branding, About; lab intro, COA reading, sample submission videos) · Facebook business page (connect correct Meta assets) · Bing Places (claim first) · Apple Business Connect · Yelp (claim; do not solicit Yelp reviews) · Reddit u/Kmd-Analytical (verify control, align artwork). RESERVE ONLY: TikTok, X, Threads. PepIndex is a third-party mention to check for accuracy, not an account to create.
Status codes per channel: Not checked · Existing · Access needed · Draft ready · Verification pending · Complete (live URL + evidence of company control).
Sequence for every profile: FIND → OPEN → DRAFT → OPTIMIZE → COMPLETE → CHECK (mobile and desktop) → CONNECT (website sameAs links) → REPORT (URL, handle, admin, recovery contact, status, evidence, next step; no passwords).
Scientific claims: approved wording only; no invented accreditation, FDA registration, clinical services, rankings, review counts or turnaround promises.

MASTER PROMPT (copy into Claude and change the platform):
"Help me complete and optimize KMD Analytical's [PLATFORM] profile. Use the attached approved brand book, actual vial and logo artwork, current service descriptions, and verified business facts. First search for an existing profile and give me candidate URLs and reasons they match. Do not assume that no search result means no account exists. I will open the platform, confirm ownership, and recover or create the account.
Once I share the real profile fields or screenshots, draft every field within the platform's current character limits: display name, handle options, short bio, About description, categories, services, website/contact links, location, hours, and call to action where supported. Leave missing facts as questions. Suggest the correct image sizes for the actual logo and banner. Use kmdanalytical.com only after I confirm it is the canonical domain.
Then audit and improve the draft for discoverability, clear service relevance, consistent business identity, credibility and conversion. Use natural wording for independent analytical testing and approved peptide/HPLC services; avoid keyword stuffing and unsupported claims. Do not invent accreditation, capabilities, reviews, guarantees or medical claims. Keep the profile consistent with the brand book.
Give me a paste-ready field checklist, image requirements, link-test checklist and verification steps. For LinkedIn, draft three approved educational posts. For Instagram, draft three pinned explainers and highlight labels. For YouTube, draft the channel About text and outlines for lab introduction, COA reading and sample submission videos. Draft only what this platform needs. Finish with a short optimization audit after I provide the completed profile URL or screenshots. Never claim the profile is live or complete unless we verify it."

FINAL CROSS-PLATFORM CHECK PROMPT:
"Review this KMD profile register: [URLs and statuses]. Compare names, addresses, phone numbers, domains, service wording and visuals against the approved brand book and company facts. Identify duplicates, mismatched details, broken links, missing verification and incomplete fields. Give me the exact fix for each. Distinguish profiles you can inspect from those I must open. Return a concise completion report for Adrian with live links and specific remaining actions."

Handoff: one compact register for all 12 channels to Adrian with live URLs, verification status, blockers, the PepIndex accuracy check and the website cross-link handoff.
References: KMD_Analytical_SEO_GEO_Scorecard_and_Activation_Checklist.pdf (pp. 4, 6–8) · Yelp: https://www.yelp-support.com/article/Don-t-Ask-for-Reviews?l=en_US

Identify duplicates, mismatched details, broken links, missing verification and incomplete fields, and give me the exact fix for each. Distinguish profiles you can inspect from those I must open. Add the PepIndex accuracy check and the website sameAs cross-link list. Return a concise completion report for Adrian with live links and the specific remaining actions.
